Questions

What is the median annual wage for Graphic designers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Graphic Designers in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $76,720.

What is the hourly median for Graphic designers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Graphic Designers in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $36.89.

How many Graphic designers work in Seattle?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 2,710 wage-and-salary Graphic Designers in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Graphic designers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.02. Values above 1.00 mean Graphic Designers are more concentrated in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Graphic designers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Graphic Designers in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $82,290.

How does Seattle's Graphic designers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Seattle's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($76,720) is $11,660 higher than Austin ($65,060) and $10,230 higher than Chicago ($66,490). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
